stem.text: A student observed the effect of two different concentrations of salt solution on blood cells.
The student added each concentration of salt solution to one of two microscope slides, and then a small drop of fresh blood was added.
Each slide was viewed using the high power lens of a microscope and the student’s observations were recorded.

rows: No red blood cells were visible.
The red blood cells were visible but looked slightly crinkled.

stem.text: Which row correctly explains the results obtained?

A.text: Swelling of the cells caused them all to burst.; The $\Psi$ of the cell was more negative than the $\Psi$ of the external solution.

B.text: The $\Psi$ of the cell was more negative than the $\Psi$ of the external solution.; The $\Psi$ of the external solution was more negative than the $\Psi$ of the cell.

C.text: The $\Psi$ of the cell was less negative than the $\Psi$ of the external solution.; There is a net movement of water out of the cell by osmosis.

D.text: The $\Psi$ of the external solution was less negative than the $\Psi$ of the cell.; The $\Psi$ of the cell was very similar to, but slightly more negative than, the $\Psi$ of the external solution.
